title: The Child Reaffirms Waheguru and Father and Son Are Imprisoned

blocks.text: When questioned again, the child firmly rejects the nawab's kalma and answers instead with the Guru-given invocation of Satnam and Waheguru. The reversal undoes the court's attempt to stage a conversion and restores the scene to the moral universe claimed by Subeg Singh.

Clerics, Quranic recitations, and renewed pressure all fail to secure a stable submission. The page emphasizes that even institutional religion allied with state power cannot master a conscience reawakened in the Guru's memory.

At last the nawab gives up on immediate success and has father and son imprisoned. The sakhi closes by preserving the episode as a remembered martyrdom sequence whose meaning lies in steadfast refusal rather than physical escape.
